gloss: big mouth; big talk; large-scale (order, client)

definitions.explanation: Literally a large or wide-open mouth; figuratively, boastful talk, mainly in the phrase {大口|おおぐち}を{叩|たた}く.
Before another noun: involving a large amount of money or goods, as in business and finance.

examples.japanese: {大口|おおぐち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}けて→開ける：00563_akeru⟧⟦{笑|わら}う→笑う：00685_warau⟧。
examples.english: He laughs with his mouth wide open.

examples.japanese: {大口|おおぐち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{叩|たた}く→叩く：02072_tataku⟧な。

⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{大口|おおぐち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{叩|たた}いた→叩く：02072_tataku⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{一回戦|いっかいせん}→一回戦：08960_ikkaisen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{負|ま}けた→負ける：01134_makeru⟧。
examples.english: The player who talked big before the tournament lost in the first round.

examples.japanese: {大口|おおぐち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}→注文：03485_chuumon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
{大口|おおぐち}⟦{顧客|こきゃく}→顧客：08632_kokyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}にする→大切にする：26940_taisetsunisuru⟧。
examples.english: We take good care of our major clients.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今月|こんげつ}→今月：00720_kongetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{大口|おおぐち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{二件|にけん}⟦{決|き}まり→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧、⟦{売上|うりあげ}→売上：04102_uriage⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{伸|の}びた→伸びる：01974_nobiru⟧。
examples.english: Two large contracts were signed this month, and sales rose sharply.

notes:
SENSE 1 is everyday speech, and its figurative use is almost always {大口|おおぐち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{叩|たた}く→叩く：02072_tataku⟧. SENSE 2 is business vocabulary and stands before another noun, with or without ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大口|おおぐち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{叩|たた}く→叩く：02072_tataku⟧: to talk big, to brag
- {大口|おおぐち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}ける→開ける：00563_akeru⟧: to open one's mouth wide
- {大口|おおぐち}⟦{顧客|こきゃく}→顧客：08632_kokyaku⟧・{大口|おおぐち}⟦{取引|とりひき}→取引：04700_torihiki⟧: major client, large transaction
- {大口|おおぐち}⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}→注文：03485_chuumon⟧: bulk order
- {大口|おおぐち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{寄付|きふ}→寄付：02584_kifu⟧: a large donation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {大|おお}{風呂敷|ぶろしき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{広|ひろ}げる→広げる：01981_hirogeru⟧: to make grandiose plans or claims
- ⟦{小口|こぐち}→小口：23841_koguchi⟧: small-lot, small-scale (the opposite of SENSE 2)
